episode.intent: What are the foiled cards that are incredibly powerful when paired with non foiled cards? List the IDs.
episode.failed_sql: SELECT id FROM cards WHERE cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL AND cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL;
episode.remediation_sql: SELECT id FROM cards WHERE hasFoil = 1 AND hasNonFoil = 1;

episode.intent: What is the percentage of players that are under 180 cm who have an overall strength of more than 70?
episode.failed_sql:
SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.height < 180 AND pa.overall_rating > 70 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa
  ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
  AND pa.date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM Player_Attributes WHERE player_api_id = p.player_api_id);
episode.remediation_sql:
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN pa.overall_rating > 70 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS percentage
FROM Player p
JOIN (
  SELECT pa1.player_api_id, pa1.overall_rating
  FROM Player_Attributes pa1
  JOIN (
    SELECT player_api_id, MAX(date) AS maxdate
    FROM Player_Attributes
    GROUP BY player_api_id
  ) m ON pa1.player_api_id = m.player_api_id AND pa1.date = m.maxdate
) pa ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.height < 180;

episode.intent: What proportion of cards do not have a text box with a normal layout?
episode.failed_sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN isTextless = 1 AND layout = 'normal' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS proportion FROM cards;
episode.remediation_sql: SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN isTextless = 0 AND layout = 'normal' THEN 0.0 ELSE 1.0 END) AS proportion FROM cards;

episode.intent: How much higher in percentage is Ariel Borysiuk's overall rating than that of Paulin Puel?
episode.failed_sql:
SELECT ROUND(((a.overall_rating - b.overall_rating) * 1.0 / b.overall_rating) * 100, 2) AS percentage_higher
FROM (
  SELECT pa.overall_rating
  FROM Player p
  JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
  JOIN (SELECT player_api_id, MAX(date) AS maxdate FROM Player_Attributes GROUP BY player_api_id) m
    ON pa.player_api_id = m.player_api_id AND pa.date = m.maxdate
  WHERE p.player_name = 'Ariel Borysiuk'
) a
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT pa.overall_rating
  FROM Player p
  JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
  JOIN (SELECT player_api_id, MAX(date) AS maxdate FROM Player_Attributes GROUP BY player_api_id) m
    ON pa.player_api_id = m.player_api_id AND pa.date = m.maxdate
  WHERE p.player_name = 'Paulin Puel'
) b;
episode.remediation_sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN puel > 0 THEN ROUND(((bory - puel) * 1.0 / puel) * 100, 2) ELSE NULL END AS percentage_higher
FROM (
  SELECT
    MAX(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Ariel Borysiuk' THEN pa.overall_rating END) AS bory,
    MAX(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Paulin Puel' THEN pa.overall_rating END) AS puel
  FROM Player p
  JOIN (
    SELECT pa1.player_api_id, pa1.overall_rating
    FROM Player_Attributes pa1
    JOIN (
      SELECT player_api_id, MAX(date) AS maxdate
      FROM Player_Attributes
      GROUP BY player_api_id
    ) m ON pa1.player_api_id = m.player_api_id AND pa1.date = m.maxdate
  ) pa ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
) t;
